notes: Pass 5 (CWE-89 SQL Injection) candidate labeling only; 1445 source rows + 297 sink rows = 1742 candidates, all covered via semantic groups (dedup) - see labels/labels_raw_pass5.json for the full row-to-group audit mapping.

Evidence verification basis: the on-disk source tree at dataset/codeql_databases/sql_injection_dbs/superset_vuln (Apache Superset 3.0.1) matches the CodeQL database source snapshot (creation sha 2f468900, per exploration/detection.json); all file:line evidence was read and verified against this tree during this session.

This run is an in-context LLM labeling session (model glm-5.3 operating the Claude Code agent harness); no external LLM API calls were made. 12 batches were processed; per-batch scope and row counts are recorded in labels_raw_pass5.json.
pass 1 block: present with zero entries solely to satisfy the labels_schema.json 'passes contains pass_id=1' constraint; no pass-1 labeling was performed in this run.

Key semantic findings: (1) the SQL Lab /execute/ flow is a complete request.json->raw-SQL path by design (request.json['sql'] -> SqlJsonExecutionContext -> SandboxedEnvironment Jinja render -> execute_sql_statements -> BaseEngineSpec.execute -> cursor.execute), gated by @protect, marshmallow type validation, post-render table-access validation and DML flags - labeled tp at the API/channel level, threat-model note recorded; (2) the chart-data ad-hoc extras.where/having path reaches raw TextClauses (self.text) and is guarded by validate_adhoc_subquery + sanitize_clause (labeled sanitizer, structural guard); (3) engine-spec adapters interpolate identifiers (hive/gsheets/presto select paths, CTAS tmp_table_name in sql_parse.py:436-441 - unquoted, TODO-acknowledged) and engine-derived cancel ids (mysql/postgres/redshift/snowflake/trino/ocient) into executed SQL; (4) session/connection.execute of Core constructs, tags.py, security/manager.py, importers and pandas read_sql_query(literal_binds) are bound/compiled channels; (5) the bound-parameter argument is the proven sanitizer channel; kwargs['rison'] and most @expose path params terminate in ORM filter()/order_by().

Extraction match_kind is 'ast' for all rows (receiver-name-agnostic matching); name-collision false positives (session.query ORM rows matched against SqlaTable.query, non-SQL f-strings in importers/benchmark script, sqlparse.format, tag-name f-string bound values) were identified and labeled none/fp individually with evidence retained.

Position caveat reconciliation (from detection.json uncoveredCases): engine-spec adapter execute call sites carry SQL at argument 1, recorded as corrected arg_index 1 (p5-sink-004); BaseEngineSpec.execute carries query at parameter 2 (p5-sink-005), the Hive @staticmethod shape at parameter 1 (p5-sink-006); the generic bound_params companion rows report arg 1 and must not be used as the SQL-text position on adapter sites.

sanitize_clause (superset/sql_parse.py:522-549) + validate_adhoc_subquery (superset/models/helpers.py:105-134) - the SQL syntax-context guard applied to every ad-hoc WHERE/HAVING/custom-SQL clause before it reaches self.text()/literal_column (_process_sql_expression, models/helpers.py:832-850): sqlparse-based single-statement enforcement, paren-balance and multiline-comment checks, plus subquery rejection unless the ALLOW_ADHOC_SUBQUERY feature flag (with RLS insertion). Note it does NOT escape quote characters (it is a structural guard), so it is a barrier for statement structure, not a general value escaper; SandboxedEnvironment (jinja_context.py:448) is the template-injection barrier on the same path. Not backed by a CSV row - documented function-level sanitizer for Phase 2 isBarrier consideration.
